title: Simulation 3D Joystick
text: Process input from asynchronous joystick device, 1 input, 3 outputs; {Joystick ID} sets the iD assigned to given joystick device, {Adjust I/O ports according to joystick capabilities} sets the option to dynamically adjust ports to correspond to joystick and {Enable force-feedback input} sets the option to support joysticks. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Axes
ports.summary: Joystick position along any given axis vector with each element in the range [-1,1]

ports.name: Buttons
ports.summary: Status of joystick buttons vector of 0 and 1

ports.name: Point of view
ports.summary: Current status of joystick point-of-view selector -1 (selector inactive) | scalar

params.name: Joystick ID
params.values: ID assigned to given joystick device 1 (default)

params.name: Adjust I/O ports according to joystick capabilities
params.values: Option to dynamically adjust ports to correspond to joystick capabilities on (default) | off

params.name: Enable force-feedback input
params.values: Option to support joysticks with force-feedback on (default) | off
